KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll

Topeka, KS

KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll is a social group ride in Topeka, KS. It meets every Wednesday, 6:10 pm, spring through fall (starts early May), starting at Washburn University parking lot, SW 20th & MacVicar. Expect about 15 miles, no drop, lycra optional.

About the KVBC Wednesday Slow Roll group ride

A 15-mile round trip on streets and trails for beginner and intermediate riders. E-bikes welcome. Often stops for ice cream near the end. Helmets and a good attitude required. Check the club's calendar or Facebook for start and end dates.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
